perspective:
Angela’s available information:

- She and Kevin have been close friends since high school, despite different career paths, and they confide in each other.
- She knows Kevin works as a construction worker and had noticed he seemed unhappy with his job.
- She invited Kevin to coffee because she was worried about him. Kevin told her he was not happy, felt stuck and unfulfilled, and was just going through the motions.
- Angela suggested he consider a different job or career path. Kevin said he had thought about it but felt overwhelmed and unsure where to start. Angela offered to help him look into options; Kevin agreed and thanked her.
- Angela later found job openings and a career counseling service. She told Kevin about them. Kevin thanked her and said she “really went all out.”
- Kevin told Angela he had been thinking a lot and was interested in something more creative, possibly design or architecture. Angela encouraged him and told him to check out the resources. Kevin said he would and thanked her.
- Angela believed Kevin was hesitant, so she arranged a meeting with a career coach. She told Kevin. He said she didn’t have to, appreciated it, but wasn’t sure he was ready. Angela encouraged him to give it a shot. Kevin agreed.
- Angela checked in about the career coach. Kevin told her the coach had been helpful, he had started online courses in design, and he felt more confident. Angela said she was proud and offered more help. Kevin said just knowing she was there was enough and he would ask if he needed anything.
- Angela organized a small celebration for Kevin’s new career. She told him he deserved it. Kevin thanked her and said it meant a lot; he said he couldn’t have done it without her. Angela credited his hard work.
- Angela’s own feelings/beliefs across these events: concerned/worried for Kevin, supportive/hopeful, frustrated/worried when he hesitated, proud/relieved when he reported progress, and happy/satisfied when she believed he had successfully transitioned to a new career.

She does not have access to anything Kevin did not tell her or she did not personally observe, including the details of his private thoughts, career coach sessions, or any hidden events beyond what he reported.
